The '''Orange Conic Era''' was a period in the history of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] that began several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Orange Conic Era saw the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|species]] enter into a time of cultural retreat and close the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]], which had long served as the gateway world to the Enclave and the main point of contact between the Gree and the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Grand Hypergate]] on Asation did not see use during the Orange Conic Era<ref name="TOR" /> until [[Raid on Asation|it was activated]] by the [[Dread Host|forces]] of the [[Dread Masters]] during the Galactic War.<ref name="Operation">{{TORcite|type=operation|Terror From Beyond}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Orange Conic Era was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Asation,<ref name="TOR" /> which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of Game Update 1.4: Terror From Beyond on [[September 26]], [[2012]].<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.4.0/terror-beyond|text=Game Update 1.4: Terror From Beyond Patch Notes}}</ref>
